booking.title: Schedule
booking.description: Ask for leave before a lesson to get a make-up, book the same lesson in another class, or switch between online and on-site.
booking.empty: No lessons in the next 60 days.
booking.postponeConfirm: Ask for leave for this lesson? It is not charged and you get a make-up right.
booking.postponeClosed: Leave closed at {deadline}. If you miss it, the lesson is still charged.
booking.cancelConfirm: Cancel this booking? Your make-up right (if any) comes back.
booking.switchHint: Switch by {deadline} · {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} left
booking.makeupsEmpty: No make-up rights yet. Ask for leave in time to get one.
booking.offerHint: Lesson {number} of {code} ({date}) has a free seat. It is held until {until}.
booking.waitingHint: Lesson {number} of {code} ({date}) — you will be offered a seat when someone cancels.

options.notOpen: This make-up right is used or expired.

flexible.description: Classes without a fixed roster: book each lesson in the next 4 weeks; each attended lesson uses one from your package.

flexible.noSessions: No lessons in the next 4 weeks.

flexible.free: Online {online, number} left · on-site {offline, number} left
flexible.freeOne: {count, plural, one {# seat} other {# seats}} left

makeups.title: Make-ups and leave
makeups.description: Review exceptional make-up requests, place them by hand, and follow learners who ask for leave often.
makeups.placeHint: Pick an upcoming session of the same level (same lesson first). Placing by hand may exceed make-up seats and the right's expiry, but a seat must be free.
